profile.headline: Software Engineer II at FedPoint
profile.summary:
As a software engineer at Infosys, I apply my skills in Ruby on Rails, Java, Go, JavaScript, and ReactJS to create web applications that meet the needs of various clients. I have worked on projects involving user interface design, database management, API integration, and testing. I also collaborate with other developers, designers, and stakeholders to ensure quality and functionality of the products.

With a background in accounting and finance, I have a keen interest in FinTech and how web development can enhance customer satisfaction and financial literacy. I have a bachelor's degree in business administration from Youngstown State University, where I learned the fundamentals of accounting, auditing, taxation, and financial analysis. I also have experience as an accountant at Durante Rentals, where I performed various tasks such as reconciliations, debt restructuring, and year-end audit preparation. I am always eager to learn new technologies and frameworks that can help me achieve my career goals in web development.
